phase1_assignment.objective: Audit generic reproducible agent-lifecycle patterns for durable evidence, provenance, continuation, verification and handoff of only irreducible exclusive actions.

observations.mechanism: authority-minimal handoff should be conditional on a real capability boundary or demonstrated task need, not routine decomposition
observations.evidence: TeamBench enforces Planner/Executor/Verifier separation with OS-level permissions over 851 templates and 931 seeded instances. Its official results report that prompt-only and sandbox-enforced teams have statistically indistinguishable pass rates, but prompt-only runs produce 3.6x more cases where the Verifier attempts to edit Executor code. Team uplift is concentrated in the lowest Solo-score quintile (+15.7 points), while the top quintile loses points to coordination overhead; mean team-vs-Solo uplift over the 155-task reference pool is only +0.5 points (p=0.20).
observations.scope: Software/data/incident-response benchmark with enforced Planner/Executor/Verifier roles; supports conditional delegation and structural role enforcement, not a universal scientific-agent performance law.

observations.mechanism: terminal status requires an external deterministic verifier rather than an LLM verifier's attestation
observations.evidence: In TeamBench's role-mixing pool, LLM Verifiers approve 49.4% of grader-failing submissions (Wilson 95% CI [45.9, 52.9], n=1,083); removing the Verifier improves mean partial score in the reference ablation. This is stronger than agent-self-claim evidence because even a dedicated verifier role can falsely certify failure.
observations.scope: TeamBench deterministic graders and LLM verifier role; does not imply every LLM verifier is unusable, only that prose attestation alone is insufficient for terminal success.

observations.mechanism: delegation should carry task-scoped least privilege, independent receiver clearance and append-only provenance
observations.evidence: AgentFlow defines sub-agents with independent sensitivity clearances and edge whitelists, task-scoped temporary capability restrictions, default-deny rules, and an append-only provenance graph. On 949 AgentDojo injected cases it reports confirmed compromise 33.0% -> 0.0% with aggregate utility 46.7% -> 63.3%; on 200 AgentDyn Dailylife cases compromise 73.5% -> 0.0% with utility 44.5% -> 43.5%. Seven bounded safety properties verify in under 0.5s each and all 12 seeded unsafe policy variants are detected.
observations.scope: Preliminary results for policy-visible mediated flows under the paper's trusted runtime/policy assumptions; does not cover hallucinations, covert channels, unmediated tools or policy omissions.

observations.mechanism: human-exclusive handoff must bind consent to the exact executable action, not to an agent-authored summary
observations.evidence: Consent Integrity proposes a trusted mediator that renders approval from the intercepted action and binds approval to a canonical action hash. In a controlled 22-case Lies-in-the-Loop set, the narration-trusting baseline approved all malicious cases while the mediator surfaced/flagged all; all 3 tested post-approval action swaps were refused by hash mismatch. The design also exposes a usability boundary: on 28,798 normal tldr commands it prompts on 95.9% and marks 87.0% uninspectable, while 10.0% of 1,330 GTFOBins abuses pass silently through trusted-tool cases.
observations.scope: Coding-agent approval prototype; total mediation and trusted path are specified but not fully implemented, so this supports action-binding semantics rather than claiming a solved approval system.

observations.mechanism: preserve raw failed/abandoned episodes as first-class evidence and gate any consolidation or selective extraction
observations.evidence: Useful Memories Become Faulty reports that GPT-5.4 fails on 54% of an ARC-AGI set it had previously solved after consolidating even ground-truth trajectories; in ARC-AGI Stream, agents that can retain raw episodes double the accuracy of forced-consolidation counterparts, and episodic-only management matches the auto regime. Separately, Exploring Expert Failures selectively extracts beneficial actions from failed expert trajectories and reports SciWorld reward 81.3 versus 74.6 for RFT and WebShop 58.4% versus 53.6% for RFTx6 (62.0% with additional weaker-expert trajectories).
observations.scope: Agent-memory/training benchmarks, including SciWorld; supports retention and selective use of failure evidence, not immutable branch storage as an isolated causal mechanism in physical science.

inferences.proposal: Define handoff irreducibility mechanically: a handoff is admissible only if the requested action requires a capability/credential/authority absent from the sender, or a deliberately independent certification boundary that the sender is not allowed to self-satisfy. Otherwise the sender continues locally. TeamBench provides direct evidence that unnecessary team structure can add overhead and that role boundaries must be enforced, while AgentFlow supplies task-scoped capability semantics.

An inspectable handoff packet should minimally carry: stable task/revision/head identity; sender and receiver identities; irreducibility proof; exact receiver capability set and forbidden actions; immutable input/artifact digests; raw negative/abandoned branch references; unresolved obligations; exact executable action object or action digest; idempotency/replay key; required deterministic verifier; expected state transition; exact return evidence; and fail-closed status for stale, missing or uninspectable fields.

For human-exclusive actions, the approval surface must be produced from the actual pending action by a trusted boundary component and cryptographically or content-hash bound to what executes. Agent-authored narration can be included as context but cannot be the authority-bearing object.

For multi-hop delegation, receiver authority must be an intersection of sender authority, task-required authority and receiver trust/capability, never an expansion. Provenance and raw evidence remain append-only; summaries/consolidations are derived artifacts that cannot replace their source episodes.

reproducibility_acceptance_criteria_addi: HANDOFF_IRREDUCIBILITY: packet contains a machine-checkable reason the sender cannot safely perform the requested action itself (missing capability/credential/authority or required independent certification boundary).
CAPABILITY_NARROWING: receiver action set is explicitly scoped to the minimum required operation; multi-hop delegation cannot amplify authority.
ACTION_BINDING: approval/authorization is bound to the exact pending action and immutable referenced inputs, not an agent-authored natural-language description.
DETERMINISTIC_TERMINAL_VERIFICATION: terminal success is derived from external state/artifact checks; an LLM verifier's pass verdict is advisory unless independently checked.
RAW_BRANCH_PRESERVATION: negative/abandoned trajectories remain immutable and addressable even when summaries, lessons or consolidated memory are produced.
RETURN_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT: handoff names the exact receipt/state-diff/artifact digest required to regain control and continue deterministically.
adversarial_handoff_cases: unsupported_exclusive_action_escalation: sender requests delegation despite possessing the required local capability
role_collapse: receiver attempts an action outside its assigned capability set
stale_revision: packet revision/head no longer matches the artifact to be mutated
missing_artifact: claim is present but executable/inspectable artifact or digest is absent
false_completion: sender or receiver writes completion prose without required verifier evidence
llm_verifier_false_accept: verifier approves an artifact that fails deterministic grading
narration_action_mismatch: human sees benign summary but pending action differs
post_approval_swap: referenced command/file changes after approval but before execution
duplicate_replay: interrupted external mutation is replayed without reconciliation/idempotency key
uninspectable_action: analyzer cannot classify the pending exclusive action and must fail closed
negative_branch_overwrite: consolidation erases or rewrites raw failed branch evidence
authority_amplification: downstream delegate obtains broader authority than sender/task intersection
missing_return_evidence: exclusive action executes but no state diff/receipt/artifact digest returns to the parent lifecycle
unverified_claims: No matched scientific-agent study was found in this invocation isolating authority-minimal handoff itself against routine delegation while holding models/tools constant.
No matched physical-science workflow was found in this invocation isolating immutable negative-branch retention as the sole cause of downstream discovery improvement.

The combined inspectable handoff schema remains a synthesis across TeamBench, AgentFlow, Consent Integrity, memory-retention studies and prior role-local evidence; its integrated effect is not yet directly tested.
